content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds Northwind. Clause 12.3 affirmatively preserves our freedom to engage any supplier and records that we have made no exclusivity or minimum-volume commitment; clause 2.1 confirms no minimum purchase commitment and that declining further Order Forms is not a breach. Clause 12.4's restriction on Brightline marketing a competing analytics service is exclusivity in our favour, which we keep. No redline proposed.
